AC-H06 test reality: 3 new files invoke real units (POST handler with mocked external deps + spied real runItems; real makePerItemExecutor with fake deps; real runItems with injected sleep), assert behavior not implementation trivia. Not trivial/tautological.
feedback: All six ACs are met and all four hard gates are green; no blocking issues. To raise robustness further next iteration: (1) AC-H04 is a reject-at-200 operational guard, not true chunking — large bulk (>200) still requires manual splitting; consider server-side batching/pagination so >200 inputs can complete safely. (2) Rate control is preventive delay only; add 429/5xx detection with exponential backoff + bounded retry in runItems (or executor) so a transient mall rate-limit does not become a per-item 'failed'. (3) Within a single item, resolveRakutenItem can call getItem twice (+ searchManageNumberBySku) with no inter-call delay — a minor request burst per item not throttled by the between-items delay. (4) Extract magic numbers (MAX_ITEMS=200, default delayMs=300) into named exported constants so route and tests share one source of truth. (5) Optionally surface delayMs/preserveExistingDisplay/MAX_ITEMS limit in MigratePanel UI and add one test asserting the dry-run path still applies the between-item delay (currently only implied).
risks: MAX_ITEMS=200 hard reject (not chunking): inputs >200 cannot complete in one request and require manual splitting; not ideal for full bulk migration of large catalogs.
No 429/5xx backoff-retry: a transient mall rate-limit during commit surfaces as per-item status='failed' rather than being retried; fixed delay is preventive only.
Per-item request burst: getItem + searchManageNumberBySku + getItem within one item are not throttled by the between-items delay.

Existing published items: when existed && preserveExistingDisplay, editItem still overwrites content fields (price/name/category) from rakuten data while preserving visibility — could overwrite manual Yahoo edits (pre-existing AC-007 behavior, out of this scope).
recommended_next_changes: Add server-side batching/chunking so inputs above the recommended limit can be processed safely instead of a hard 400 reject.
Add 429/5xx detection with bounded exponential backoff + retry inside runItems/executor so transient rate-limits do not become 'failed'.
Throttle or short-circuit the second getItem in resolveRakutenItem to avoid intra-item request bursts.
Promote MAX_ITEMS (200) and default delayMs (300) to named exported constants shared by route and tests.
Surface delayMs / preserveExistingDisplay / item limit in MigratePanel and add a test asserting the between-item delay also applies on the dry-run path.
